metadata.description: AST-expansion conformance fixture for grids/latlon3d/rules/central_D_lev_zero_grad_bc, bound to NLON=8, NLAT=5, NLEV=5 at the import edge. The match D(u,lev) on a [lon,lat,lev] field must lower, through the section-9.6.3 fixpoint, to the rule's rank-3 three-region makearray — interior levels [1,8] x [1,5] x [2,4] holding the imported nonuniform centered stencil, plus the k=1 bottom face and k=5 top face one-sided closures — with all metaparameters folded and the consumer level centers surviving as the free-name array zc (declared here as a simple lev-shaped observed so the fixture is self-contained; its value is irrelevant to the syntactic lowering). The golden pins the byte-identical post-lowering AST across bindings.
